def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objs = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if not color or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [(y - minr, x - minc) for y, x in cells]
            objs.append((color, shape, max(y - minr for y, x in cells) + 1,
                         max(x - minc for y, x in cells) + 1))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    # Pack the components into the lower part of the canvas, in reading order.
    objs.sort(key=lambda o: (o[0], -len(o[1])))
    positions = [(5, 0), (5, 5), (8, 0), (8, 5)]
    for i, (color, shape, sh, sw) in enumerate(objs):
        base_r, base_c = positions[i % len(positions)]
        if base_c + sw > w:
            base_c = w - sw
        if base_r + sh > h:
            base_r = h - sh
        for dy, dx in shape:
            out[base_r + dy][base_c + dx] = color
    return out
